title: Beautiful palace, don't miss it!
text: Wonderful experience, the architecture is just beautiful. It was +40 the day we went so we were glad there was a cafeteria with shady tables and cold drinks. Also the walk through the gardens were a welcome relief from the heat.
author: sonia_k

title: Good customer service
text: We went to the office to pick up our tickets for the Alcázar and the girl who helped us (Andrea) was very kind. She explained not only how to access the Alcázar, but she also gave us some very good recommendations about the city.
author: darianc347

title: Nice grounds
text: But chaotic on entry make sure you pick up tickets from redemption point first TA barcode doesn’t let you in
